overview: Docket: Grummon reports Dairen postal authorities interfered with foreigners' mail to China, citing American businessman Morgan.

people.name: Stuart E. Grummon
people.role: U.S. official at Dairen; sender of the indexed communication

people.name: William A. Morgan
people.role: Dairen representative of Frazer Federal, U.S.A.

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry on postal interference at Dairen
subfiles.to: FE (Far Eastern office, Department of State)
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a report about local postal authorities attempting to interfere with foreigners’ letters from Dairen to China.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Grummon's 1937 report on Dairen postal interference with foreigners' mail to China, citing Morgan.

interest: Index on 1937 postal interference with mail at Dairen.
